scope: Durable project/metadata saves and fault-injected or interrupted save qualification
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image (Qt 6.12.0, glibc via archlinux 2026-10-20 snapshot), overlay filesystem in docker --network none

pipewire-sanitize.note: pipewire-private-graph failed on the known dropped-cycle capture flake handled by PR #111; unrelated to saves

finding: QSaveFile::commit() does not call fsync/fdatasync (the injected sync fault never fired before the fix). Saves now flush, fdatasync the temporary, publish, then fsync the directory.

observation.scope: LD_PRELOAD write/sync/rename faults and SIGKILL during saves; no power loss

verified_behaviors: write (ENOSPC after 512 bytes), sync (EIO) and publish (rename/renameat/renameat2/linkat, EIO) faults make Session::saveProject fail for both overwrite and Save As

After each fault: destination bytes, an unrelated neighbor file and the directory listing are unchanged; tempo/pitch edits, project path, unsaved state and Undo/Redo are kept; the destination still opens
Undo, Redo and a subsequent save work after the faults

40 SIGKILLs at random points during alternating saves of two 129 KB projects always leave a complete copy of one of them; no stray temporaries were observed; the project reopens through Session::loadProject
limits: No power-loss, real full-disk, network-filesystem or concurrent-writer testing. LD_PRELOAD interposition covers Qt's libc calls on this platform only.
